sections.3-1-from-history-to-examination-plan: Patient ke kapre badalne se pehle ek minute ruk kar examination ka plan likh lein. Yeh aadat achhe clinician ki pehchan hai.
sections.3-2-the-standard-order-of-examination: Examination ki tarteeb: dekhna, active movement, passive movement, resisted tests, neuro exam, special tests aur palpation.
sections.3-3-end-feels-in-plain-language: End-feel ka matlab hai movement ke aakhir mein haath ko kya mehsoos hota hai: soft, firm, hard ya ghair-normal (jaise khali ya spasm).
sections.3-4-neurological-examination-when-and-ho: Neuro exam tab karein jab symptoms kohni ya ghutne se neeche jayein, sunn-pan ya kamzori ho. Dermatomes, myotomes aur reflexes dono taraf.
sections.3-5-lower-motor-neuron-versus-upper-moto: LMN (nerve) aur UMN (dimagh ya cord) ka farq: tone, reflexes, sukhna aur Babinski jaise signs.
sections.3-6-clinical-reasoning-questions: Sawaal hal karein. Sirf kamar dard ho, taang mein kuch na ho, to aam taur par poora neuro test zaroori nahi.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
